description: Use for 'set up / incorporate / register a company in X' — e.g. 'Wyoming LLC formation cost' (country US), 'Dubai free zone company requirements' (country AE), 'Prospera LLC' (country Honduras or Prospera). Give the country (ISO-3166 code or English name; a US state resolves to the US, 'Prospera' to Honduras), optional `entity_type` filter (for example: llc, corporation, free_zone, ibc). Returns formation requirements, minimum investment, annual cost, time-to-formation, benefits, and tax notes.

country.description: Country to incorporate in: ISO-3166 alpha-2/alpha-3 code or English name, e.g. 'US', 'USA', 'United States'.

entity_type.description: Exact entity type to filter on, e.g. 'llc', 'corporation', 'free_zone', 'ibc'. Omit to list every structure on file.

name: get_company_formation
title: Get company formation options
